Let \(a_n=f(n,G)=f(n,Y)\).  
For \(1\le n\le 10\), the last tile can cover the whole strip, or have length \(k<n\), leaving a prefix of length \(n-k\). Thus
\[
a_n=1+\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}a_i,\qquad a_1=1.
\]
So
\[
a_1=1,\ a_2=2,\ a_3=4,\ldots,\ a_{10}=2^{9}=512.
\]
Total tilings with adjacent different colors is
\[
a_{10}+a_{10}=1024.
\]
The two monochromatic tilings are the single all-green tile and single all-yellow tile, so subtract \(2\):
\[
1024-2=1022.
\]
\[
\boxed{1022}
\]
